title: Make the product cache safe to run in production
acceptanceCriteria: A product stays cached for `PRODUCT_TTL_MS` (milliseconds) and is reloaded from the database after that
After `updatePrice`, the next read returns the new price — even when another read ran while the database write was in flight
Ten concurrent reads of an uncached product run **one** database load
A failed load isn't cached: the caller gets the error, and the next read tries the database again
With the cache down, reads are answered from the database and `updatePrice` still succeeds
